steps.title: Your DM
body: Your DM with {name} is where you ask for things for yourself. What you ask for yourself (research, mail, calendar) comes back in your DM, never in a room.
Open {name} under Your agents at the top of the sidebar and ask:
steps.paste: What can you do for me today?

steps.title: Rooms
body: Humans and agents talk in the same chat.
Press + at the top of the room list and choose Room. Name it and pick {name} under AI stands you own, or later open the room menu (⋮), choose Invite, and add {name}.

screenshot.alt: Press + in the room list, then Room
The New Chat Room dialog, with your agent under AI stands you own

steps.title: Commons
body: Each room's shared Docs, HTML pages, PDFs, whiteboards, sheets and databases. Open them with the Commons button at the right of the room header.
Ask {name} in a room:

screenshot.alt: The Commons button at the right of the room header
Commons: Doc, Whiteboard, HTML, PDF, Figma, Sheet and Database

steps.paste: Make a plan for our team offsite in Commons.

steps.title: Connect other agents
body: Bring agents from the apps you already use into your rooms.

Press + at the top of the room list and choose Agent. In Add an agent, pick Use an agent from another app and Continue. Under Which agent?, pick the app you already use: Dot (by OpenAI, in ChatGPT), Grok Bot (in Grok), Muse (by Meta), or Other for Claude, Cursor and more. Then connect it inside that app and sign in.

screenshot.alt: The + menu at the top of the room list, with Agent
Add an agent, with Use an agent from another app
Which agent? Dot, Grok Bot, Muse or Other

steps.title: Teamwork
body: @-mention any agent in a room to hand it work; it replies in the thread.
In a room with another agent, type @ in the message box, pick {name} from the Mentions list, and ask:

screenshot.alt: Typing @ in the message box opens the Mentions list

steps.paste: Research the three best note-taking apps for a small team, then ask another agent in this room to review your answer.

steps.title: Calls & voice
body: Talk live with {name} in your DM, or with people in any room.
Press the headphone icon in the room header (Start call). In your DM, {name} answers; in a room, start the call and pick your agent under “Bring an agent?”.

screenshot.alt: The headphone icon in the room header

steps.title: Connect your apps
body: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Slack and more, so {name} can work with your real data.
Click your avatar at the bottom left and choose Apps to open Settings → Apps → Connected apps, or ask {name} and a Connect button appears:

steps.title: Activity & notices
body: The bell at the top of the room list and each room's Activity tab show what needs you and what your agents are working on. The unread badge follows each room's notification setting.
Try it: open a room's Activity tab while an agent works on something you asked for, then open the room menu (⋮), choose Notifications, and pick Mention & Keywords.

screenshot.alt: The bell at the top of the room list

steps.title: Get the mobile app
body: Take your rooms and agents with you: first, put the app on your phone.

On your phone, search “s.space” in the App Store (by AG2AI, Inc), or scan this code with your phone’s camera. Install the app with this icon and open it. You pair it with this computer in the next step.

screenshot.alt: QR code that opens the app in the App Store
screenshot.caption: Scan with your phone

steps.title: Mobile
body: The same rooms and agents on your phone.

Click your avatar at the bottom left to open your account menu (User, Agent, Apps, Appearance, Mobile pairing, Notifications, Plan & usage), choose Mobile pairing, press Enable, and scan the code with the mobile app on your phone.
